findings.observation: The complete sword is visible, but the pommel and blade tip sit only about 5% from the top and bottom edges, violating the declared 8% safe margin.
Exactly one complete isolated sword is present, with no scabbard, character, second weapon, or loose equipment.
The straight double-edged blade, crossguard, long two-hand-capable grip, and pommel read immediately as a practical hand-and-a-half sword.
Blade shoulders seat cleanly against a functional crossguard, the grip is proportioned for one or two hands, and the substantial pommel plausibly balances the long blade.
Sunsteel forms the entire blade and structural hilt metal, with neutral dark leather as the only subordinate material and no competing rank signal.
A physically integrated warm solar-metal core runs inside the cool forged blade faces, paired with crisp high-grade edge geometry to establish sunsteel beyond palette alone.
Solar emission is confined to the narrow central blade channel and tiny hilt accents; the blade faces, grip, guard, and pommel do not glow.
The candidate uses premium realistic painterly metal, restrained wear, cold blue key, warm solar rim, midnight-charcoal backdrop, and a subtle floor plane.

Inspection found no transferred subject, published-character resemblance, rarity rainbow, gold inflation, full-object glow, oversized silhouette, ornamental material substitution, extra gear, text, labels, UI, border, frame, logo, or watermark.
